## 9. FAQ

**Frequently Asked Questions:** https://me-qr.com/faq  
**Account:** 

What are the benefits of using an account?
By creating an account you can store all your created QR codes in one place; see the statistics on each code’s scan; delete QR codes; change the content of QR codes without changing the appearance; change the QR code type; use ALL QR codes without advertising, in case of buying a subscription.

How can I recover my password if I've forgotten it?
You can recover your password by following this link: https://me-qr.com/reset-password.

How can I delete my account?
You can delete your account in the Personal Info section, but do not forget to cancel your subscription before doing so. If you have difficulties with the subscription - please contact support@me-qr.com.

How do I cancel my subscription?
You can stop your subscription in the account under Premium Subscription. You can also contact support via live chat or email us in the Support section of your account and we will help you.

After subscribing to the Premium version, will the ads be removed for free QR?
Yes, ads will be removed, but codes should be in the account.

How can I get an invoice to use for company documentation?
Please, fill in Personal Info in the account, and after payment, you will get the invoice with purchase data. Also, you will be able to download it in the account section if you make changes after payment.

How do I change my account email?
Click My QR Codes - Personal Info, and enter the new email under the Email field.

Will I lose my original free QR after subscribing to the Premium?
No, your original QR will remain, but it is necessary to have them in the account. If the code is not in the account, please contact us and send the code and the account's email.

Will I lose all the QR after my subscription ended?
No, all your codes will work, just ads will be shown again.

**QR Codes:** 

Can I use my QR code without a subscription?
Yes, you can use your QR code without paying. We offer a free version, which differs from a Premium subscription in the presence of ads after scanning.

Do your QR codes have a scanning limit?
No, our QR codes have no scanning limit.

Can I attach a QR Code created with another program to my ME-QR account?
No. We only allow users to add codes that have been created through our service to their profiles. Even if you create a QR code without registering, it gets a special ID address. We use it to identify and link to your account.

How do I delete a QR code?
You can delete a QR code by yourself in your account. If you don't have an account, create one, then contact our support team. We'll need your QR code and the email you use for your account. An operator will add the QR code to your account so you can manage it.

Can I create a QR code for my social networks?
You can create a QR for any link, including your social media or social media post. You can read more about this in our Blog.

What does the "Do Not Index" field mean when creating a QR code?
If you choose not to index, your information will not be shown by search engines.

Is there an expiration time for QR codes?
No, our QR codes do not have a time limit. You can use them for as long as you need.

What if I created a QR code before creating my account/subscription?
If this happens, please contact our support team. You'll need to send us the QR code and email so we can link the QR code to your account.

Can I edit a QR code created with another program on your site?
No. Our site does not provide this option. But you can always create a QR code on our site, use and edit it without any restrictions.

Can I change a QR code without changing its appearance?
Yes, our codes are dynamic, so you can change not only the content but also the type of code itself. These functions are available in your account.

How do I create a QR code for my restaurant menu?
With our e-menu creation service. All you need is a PDF of your menu. Then select images and social media buttons, upload your menu, and generate a QR code.

What happens to my QR code if I don't use it?
If you have created a QR code on the ME-QR website but have not registered, it will be blocked and removed unless scanned within 365 days. If you have registered, you will be sent a one month warning before the QR code is blocked and removed. After 365 days of inactivity, the code is blocked for one month. During this period it is still possible to restore its content and the QR code itself. After the month has passed, the QR code is permanently deleted.

What are the rules for placing content on a QR code?
Content on the ME-QR website must not contain spam, malicious links, fraud, child abuse, sexual content, offensive or provocative content, hate speech, cruelty to animals, advertising of illegal substances and weapons, gambling. Content that violates the rules will be removed without warning.

How often are QR code scan statistics deleted?
QR-code scanning statistics is deleted depending on tariff plan: Free - after one year, Lite/Premium - after 3 years.

**Scanner:** 

Can I scan a QR code with your service?
Yes, we have a scanner, that you can use to scan your QR codes.

Does your service have a scanner app?
Yes, we have a ME-QR Scanner, which you can download for both Android and iPhone. Our app is equipped with antivirus and phishing defense to protect you as a user. In addition, you get a nice bonus in the form of discount coupons for buying different products in an app.
Can I scan a QR code online?

Yes, you can scan a QR code online with our scanner. You don't need to download or install anything to do this.

**Premium:**

Will I lose my original free QR after subscribing to the Premium?
No, your original QR will remain, but it is necessary to have them in the account. If the code is not in the account, please contact us and send the code and the account's email.
After subscribing to the premium version, will the ads be removed for the free QR?
Yes, ads will be removed, but codes should be in the account.

Will I lose all the QR after my subscription ended?
No, all your codes will work, just ads will be shown again.

How can I delete my account?
You can delete your account in the Personal Info section, but do not forget to cancel your subscription before doing so. If you have difficulties with the subscription - please contact support@me-qr.com.

How do I cancel my subscription?
You can stop your subscription in the account under Premium Subscription. You can also contact support via live chat or email us in the Support section of your account and we will help you.

## 13.  REVIEWS

**Great for Product Launch Campaigns**
ME-QR gave us valuable insights during our latest product launch. We used QR codes in both digital and physical ads, and the analytics clearly showed where engagement was strongest. While the platform works well overall, I’d love to see more advanced segmentation options in the reporting. Still, it's a solid tool that’s improved our campaign tracking.
**Ideal for Outreach Campaigns**
We’ve used ME-QR in several outreach initiatives to track engagement with informational materials. Being able to monitor scans in real-time helps us adjust our strategy quickly. It’s intuitive, effective, and a great value for what it offers.
**Praktisch und benutzerfreundlich**
ME-QR ist eine großartige Lösung für unsere Informationsmaterialien. Wir nutzen die QR-Codes auf Flyern, Plakaten und Event-Badges. Die Nutzerfreundlichkeit und das Design der Plattform sind top. Besonders hilfreich sind die Scan-Daten, um das Interesse zu messen.
**Una herramienta útil para nuestras campañas en medios impresos**
Llevamos meses utilizando ME-QR en nuestras campañas en revistas y folletos. La posibilidad de cambiar la URL sin tener que generar un nuevo código es muy útil. Echo en falta algunas opciones de personalización avanzadas, pero en general estamos satisfechos.
**Simplifies Link Sharing and Tracking**
I’ve been using ME-QR mainly for distributing content via brochures and newsletters. It’s super helpful to see how often each piece gets scanned. The platform is user-friendly, and the analytics are clear and insightful. It’s made our content distribution strategy much more data-driven.
**Seamless Event Updates with Dynamic QR Codes**
We’ve been using Me-QR’s dynamic QR codes for event registrations, schedules, and feedback forms — and it’s been a game-changer. The ability to update content even after printing saves us from last-minute disasters. Our attendees appreciate the seamless access to updated information, and it’s helped us run events more smoothly while reducing printing costs significantly.
[TrustPilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/me-qr.com)

More details: https://me-qr.com/customers

—
